log.msg: Ten-second test, cold, 1280 shot: stranger sentence - a page comparing eight different ways to lay out the same fake blog (Magazine front, Dashboard front, Deck front, Columns, Two-level rail, Dynamic rail, Parts as columns, Parts in place), grouped as Fronts/Rails/Parts, with a stated rule that no reading column ever exceeds 42em. meant sentence (readme.md + page.js description) - the same: eight blog shells rendering the same eight posts so layout is the only variable, judged at 3440 first. The two sentences already agreed before any fix - this realm is unusually well documented (every candidate carries its own description: and finding: fields).

Primary interaction: first card in the wall is Magazine front. ui-test plan (blogx-plan.json) clicked .page-preview:has-text(Magazine front) - location.pathname became /imagine/blogx/front/, .blogx-hero-title read The layout generator (a real post), zero console errors across all 6 steps. Control does exactly what its label promises.

Layout at 3440, critique row (paging/critique, rank 11, score 89): 39pct wide, 1856px dead, depth 6, scroll 1392/1392 - weak: eight shell cards sit in a tight 4x2 grid inside a 40em lane despite the pages own verdict that a wide screen gets more columns never a wider one; alt: tile wall at wide, one row of eight instead of two of four. STATUS: applied, not reverted - changed width: large to width: fill on the index page.js (this page is a LEAF under the /imagine/ columns host - every candidate escapes to its own full screen via Blog.js container(), so nothing ever opens beside this column, exactly the case doc/columns.md recommends fill for). fill is NOT full (full was reverted on /imagine/gallery/ for collapsing the hub rail; fill has no :has() collapse rule and lets neighbours keep their floor, per Page.css). Measured after: wall rect x=480.6 width=2909.8 right=3390.4 of 3440 - dead space fell from 1856px to about 50px, all 8 cards now render in one row. Hub rail confirmed intact and unmoved (x:0, width 432px) at both 1280 and 3440. No word wide exists in this codebase (words are small/hug/large/fill/full) - alt is read as intent, applied via fill.

Other invariant checks at 3440: nothing of blogx own content sits at x:0 (the hub rail at x:0 is site chrome, not this realms content). Longest paragraph in .page-column-prose measured 648px = 40.5em, under the 42em ceiling everywhere. Scanned blogx.css for hard-coded spacing vs clamp - all gaps found are small em values on inline icon+label rows (0.1-0.7em), not page-level rhythm constants; no violation found.

Fix 2 (bigger than the layout one): doc/*.md links dead-end. Router.js line 35 explicitly declines to intercept any link ending in an extension (/\.\w+$/, comment cites /readme.md as the example) so a click on [readme.md](.../readme.md) or [doc/decisions.md](.../doc/decisions.md) does a full browser nav to the raw file (curl confirmed Content-Type: text/markdown on both). Worse: /imagine/blogx/doc/decisions/ (the clean directory route) 404d client-side too - blogx never opted into ext/Doc, so there was no working destination at all, unlike readme/ which resolves via core Page.class.js childs generic Page.file() fallback. Fixed by creating public/imagine/blogx/doc/page.js (route(name) pattern copied from the public/blog/doc/page.js precedent - route() not children:, so it does not add a 9th card to the eight-shells wall) and rewriting all 4 occurrences of the .md links in readme.md and page.js to trailing-slash urls (readme/, doc/decisions/). Also fixed readme.md own link to core/Page/doc/columns.md (a different modules doc, already working there via ext/Doc) to drop the .md the same way. Verified by clicking (not just navigating) with ui-test: doc/decisions/ now renders the full Decisions note as a real column, document.title updates, zero console errors; readme/ still renders correctly (one benign, pre-existing 404 on the generic Page.file() probe itself - .../readme/page.js 404s before the .md fallback runs, which is the same behavior every readme/ link on the site relies on, not something I introduced).

Caveats: (1) fill assumes blogx index stays a leaf - if a future candidate is ever opened AS a column instead of escaping to its own screen (Blog.js container()/render()), fill would compete with it for the row and large would be the safer word again; undo by reverting width to large. (2) doc/page.js is undeclared in blogx/page.js children: on purpose (keeps the eight-card count honest) - if the owner wants a Docs tab like other modules, ext/Doc is the real answer, not this route() shim; noted, not proposed as core surgery since this is an in-fence page.js. (3) Swept all 8 candidates + index for console errors headless at 1280: zero everywhere.

Re-shot 1280 and 3440 after fixes (blogx-after-*.png in scratchpad; final 1280 jpg at framework/ai/2026-09-04/imagine-review/shots/blogx.jpg, 93.5KB). Zero console errors on both. No core/ext proposal needed - both fixes landed entirely inside public/imagine/blogx/.

assign.outcome:
**Blogx already said what it was — its links just didn't go anywhere.** Ten-second test passed cold: the index reads as *eight ways to lay out the same fake blog* and that matches `readme.md`/`page.js` exactly, unusual for this wave. Two real defects found and fixed, both in-fence:

1. **Layout at 3440** — [paging/critique](/imagine/paging/critique/) rank 11: 39% wide, 1856px dead, while the page's own thesis is *"a wide screen gets more columns, never a wider one"* — its own index broke its own rule. Fixed: `width: "large"` → `width: "fill"` on [`page.js`](/imagine/blogx/page.js) (safe here — this column is a leaf, nothing ever opens beside it; `full` was rejected, same collapse risk flagged for `/imagine/gallery/`). Dead space measured 1856px → ~50px, all 8 cards now one row, hub rail confirmed intact at 1280 and 3440.
2. **Every `doc/*.md` link dead-ended.** `Router.js` never intercepts a link ending in an extension, so `[readme.md](...readme.md)` and `[doc/decisions.md](...doc/decisions.md)` did full page-loads onto raw `text/markdown` — and the clean directory route (`doc/decisions/`) 404'd too, since blogx never opted into `ext/Doc`. Fixed: added [`doc/page.js`](/imagine/blogx/doc/) (the `blog/doc/page.js` `route()` pattern, undeclared so it isn't a 9th card) and rewrote all 4 links in `readme.md`/`page.js` to trailing-slash urls. Verified by clicking (not just navigating): both now render as real columns, zero console errors.

Primary interaction (first card, *Magazine front*) proven end to end with `ui-test`: click → `/imagine/blogx/front/` → real post renders. Swept all 8 candidates + index: zero console errors everywhere, before and after.

**Left open:** blogx has no real `ext/Doc` Docs tab (the `route()` shim only serves the one file it has) — proposing that is core/ext surgery, not a page.js edit, so it's named here rather than attempted.
